description.value: Willingdon Community Centre is a City of Burnaby-operated civic recreation facility set within Willingdon Heights Park in northwest Burnaby. It offers weight and cardio rooms, fitness and yoga classes, and gym and racquet sports alongside children's and preschool programs. As a publicly accessible facility in a park setting, it could serve as an urban rest point for cyclists riding through the area, though no dedicated cycling services are advertised.
